solutions.latex:
Probabilities sum to 1:

$$\begin{aligned}0.1+a+b+0.2+0.2&=1\\ a+b&=0.5\quad(1)\end{aligned}$$

Expected value is 3.2:

$$\begin{aligned}1\times 0.1+2a+3b+4\times 0.2+5\times 0.2&=3.2\\ 2a+3b&=1.3\quad(2)\end{aligned}$$

Rearrange (1): $a=0.5-b$

Substitute in (2):

$$\begin{aligned}2(0.5-b)+3b&=1.3\\ 1-2b+3b&=1.3\\ b&=0.3\end{aligned}$$

$$\therefore\ a=0.2,\ b=0.3$$

$$\begin{aligned}2\cos(d-1)+2&=0\\ 2\cos(d-1)&=-2\\ \cos(d-1)&=-1\\ d-1&=\pi\\ d&=\pi+1\end{aligned}$$
